dataset_title: Flemish roadside and nature grass quality survey: reported group-level findings
source_title: Kwaliteitsanalyse van berm- en natuurmaaisel met het oog op raffinage en verdere valorisatie
commissioned_by: Natuurinvest; project partners included Agentschap voor Natuur en Bos, Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer, De Vlaamse Waterweg, and OVAM
source_location: Sampling design and conclusions sections; report states the survey covered approximately 25 ANB nature-grass lots, 25 DVW waterway-verge lots, 13 AWV motorway-verge lots, and 12 AWV regional-road verge lots. The cited accessible PDF references a separate Excel appendix, but that workbook was not available through the retrieved public copy.
license: No explicit dataset or report reuse license was identified. Only brief aggregate factual findings are transcribed with attribution; the referenced Excel appendix and individual laboratory certificates are not redistributed.
data_basis: Reported group-level counts and qualitative conclusions; no raw sample concentrations are included.
applicability: Belgian roadside and nature clipping survey; useful to prioritize Dutch feedstock sampling and contaminant screening, not a substitute for Dutch or GreenHub feed measurements.
limitations: Sample counts are approximate as reported by the source.
Samples were taken from recently deposited grass lots and are not a controlled harvest-yield study.
Individual sample measurements and numerical metal concentrations are not included in the accessible PDF text.
The heavy-metal comparison is against the cited Keurcompost guideline version 7.0, not a GreenHub feed, digestate, product, or regulatory acceptance specification.
The survey reports group-level findings; no site-level distribution, detection limits, replicate uncertainty, or feedstock mass weighting is available here.
Reference-only; no runtime mapping or process default activation.
